common.storefront.form.namePlaceholderWarning: This looks like an auto-generated name. Visitors see it as your page title, heading and share text — enter the name you want to be known by. Until then, your public page shows your account name instead.
common.storefront.form.presetBelowFloor: Below the $10 minimum — hidden on your page
common.storefront.form.floorExplainer: Dynopay's minimum for any crypto payment is $10 — network fees make smaller amounts uneconomical. Presets below $10 are not shown to supporters.
common.storefront.form.floorHiddenPresets: Crossed-out presets are hidden on your page — remove them or raise them to $10+.
common.directPayWarning: Anyone paying this address directly skips the amount and network checks of the hosted checkout. Share the payment link instead unless your customer knows exactly what to send.

common.productEditor.aiApplied: AI suggested a VAT treatment — review before saving.

common.productEditor.serviceCalendarHint: If set, buyers see this booking link on their receipt so they can schedule with you.
common.productEditor.vatReducedHint: Applies each destination country's reduced band for the category below (falls back to the standard rate where a country has none).
common.productEditor.vatZeroHint: Buyers are charged 0% VAT (zero-rated, still an in-scope taxable supply).
common.productEditor.vatStandardHint: Buyers are charged the destination country's standard VAT/GST rate.
common.productEditor.reducedCategoryHint: Rates are indicative and vary by country — confirm eligibility with your tax adviser.

common.paymentResult.verify.slow: This is taking longer than usual. Your payment is safe — keep this page open, or check Transactions in a few minutes.
common.paymentResult.verify.checking: We're confirming the payment with the provider. This usually takes under 10 seconds — don't close this page.
common.paymentResult.verify.nothingBody: This page only works when a payment provider sends you back to it. If you just paid, your Transactions list shows the current status.
common.paymentResult.verify.errorTitle: We couldn't confirm the payment yet
common.paymentResult.verify.errorBody: The provider didn't answer. If money left your account it is not lost — it will show under Transactions once confirmed, and support can trace it with your reference.
common.paymentResult.nextCredit: The amount is credited to your Dynopay wallet within a few minutes.
common.paymentResult.nextReceipt: A receipt is on its way to your e-mail — keep the transaction ID above for your records.
common.paymentResult.nextTransactions: You can follow it under Transactions in your dashboard.
common.paymentResult.failed.expired: The payment window closed before the payment was completed. Nothing was charged — you can start again whenever you're ready.
common.paymentResult.failed.cancelled: The payment was cancelled before it completed. Nothing was charged.
common.paymentResult.failed.underpaid: The amount that arrived was less than the amount due, so the payment couldn't be completed. Check the request and try again.
common.paymentResult.failed.declined: The payment was declined by the provider. Try another method or contact your bank.
common.paymentResult.failed.next: Nothing to undo — no money moved. If you were charged anyway, keep the reference below and contact support; we'll sort it out.
common.donation.acceptedCoins: Pay with your favourite crypto — 12 coins accepted
common.donation.fundHandlingBody: Your gift goes directly to ${organizer}. Depending on their settings it's received as crypto or automatically converted to a stablecoin. Dynopay only processes the payment — it never holds or invests your donation.
common.donation.taxNoteBody: In many places crypto is treated as property, so keep your own records for larger gifts and check the tax rules where you live — this isn't financial or tax advice. Crypto payments are final and generally can't be reversed, so please double-check the amount before you send. For a refund, contact the organizer directly.
common.donation.faqMinimumA: Yes — the minimum for this campaign is ${minAmountLabel}. You can give any amount at or above that.
common.donation.faqConfirmA: Most payments confirm within a few minutes once the network processes your transaction. Faster chains and stablecoins are usually quickest; Bitcoin can take a little longer.
common.donation.faqAnonA: Yes. Tick “Donate anonymously” and your name won't be shown on the public supporters list. If you leave an email we'll still send you a private receipt.
common.donation.faqRefundA: Crypto payments are final, so refunds aren't automatic. If something went wrong, contact ${organizer} directly and they can arrange one.
common.donation.faqContactQ: Who do I contact for help?
common.donation.faqContactA: Reach out to ${organizer} for anything about this campaign. For payment issues you can also contact Dynopay support from your receipt.
common.checkout.linkExpiredAsk: Ask the merchant for a new payment link and quote the reference above.
common.checkout.incompletePaymentDesc: You have a pending payment of ${incompletePayment.pending_amount} ${incompletePayment.currency}. Please complete it within ${incompletePayment.remaining_minutes} minutes or wait for it to expire.

dashboardLayout.gs.noWalletQ: Don't have a crypto wallet yet?
dashboardLayout.gs.noWalletIntro: A wallet is a free app that holds your coins — you keep the keys, Dynopay only forwards payments to it. Installing one takes about a minute.
dashboardLayout.gs.quickPathBody: Add a single USDT (Tron) address — fees are cents and it settles in seconds. You can accept every other coin later, or turn on auto-convert so everything lands as USDT.
dashboardLayout.gs.noWalletSteps: Install → create a wallet → write down the recovery phrase → tap Receive, pick the coin, copy the address → paste it here.

dashboardLayout.firstPayment.title: You got your first payment! 🎉
